**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Register the readback handler with the API gateway**

When the service runs through the repository's canonical `api/index.js` gateway, `GET /api/learning/questions/kg-v0-readback` never invokes this handler: `api/_runtime/route-registry.js` only registers the exact `^/api/learning/questions$` route, so `findRoute` returns no route and the gateway responds with `endpoint_not_found` (404). Add a dedicated authenticated GET registry entry for this handler; otherwise the new product boundary is unreachable despite its direct handler tests passing.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in c01780d1f. The canonical registry now includes a dedicated JWT-required GET route for /api/learning/questions/kg-v0-readback. A new api/index.js gateway regression authenticates with the local test identity, reaches the real handler, and asserts the exact structural Question/QuestionPart response, semantic-unavailable posture, and zero integrity counters. Local verification passed: gateway 10/10, registry contract/policy/collision 22/22, Stage 2 13/13, adapter 4/4, pinned ESLint, artifact byte identity, and Stage 1 validation/tests.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep full-corpus indexing off the request path**

On the first authenticated readback request in each process, this function synchronously reads, hashes, parses, validates, and indexes the 17 MB nodes file and 15 MB edges file on the gateway's event loop. With the exact checked-in artifacts, a clean local invocation took about 760 ms and raised RSS from roughly 46 MB to 168 MB, so concurrent requests to unrelated API routes stall during initialization and every worker retains a sizable corpus cache afterward. Precompute a compact lookup index or initialize the corpus outside the request-serving event loop.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Resolved in exact head `754417855f3c38569bb5c32a9576d34800ce374a` (tree `bde77e9934b76c41753de42caaf498db3036951e`). Runtime cache misses now authenticate/read/parse/index the Stage 1 manifest/nodes/edges in a one-shot worker, never on the request event loop. Full-corpus worker concurrency is globally serialized at 1, identical in-flight requests are deduplicated, and the main process retains only compact responses (max 16, TTL 5m); `readback.json` remains proof-only. A cold diagnostic measured 277ms lookup, 6ms maximum heartbeat gap, RSS 47→61MB after worker exit+GC, and zero active workers. The concurrency regression submits 3 distinct misses plus 1 duplicate and proves exactly 3 worker starts, peak active count 1, and zero queued/in-flight/active work afterward. Current focused Jest matrix: 48/48 PASS; Stage 1 tests: 15/15 PASS; byte-identical proof, validate-only, ESLint, and diff checks all PASS.
